reviews.text:
Dr. Leonardo is great. He was the first veterinarian my puppy saw, always very clear and objective. He has a lot of experience. We really liked his service and trusted him completely.

I highly recommend him, and if you are looking for a trustworthy veterinarian, you can trust him. Congratulations on your work!

Maria Regina, thank you so much for your 5-star review.

Your trust is very important to my work. Each review I receive further reinforces my commitment to providing veterinary care in São Paulo with seriousness, attention, and respect for each pet and each family served.

Caring for dogs and cats requires responsibility, patience, and clear guidance, whether for consultations, vaccinations, follow-ups, or home veterinary visits.

Thank you for taking the time to rate my service.

Count on me to care for your pet's health and well-being with affection, safety, and professionalism.

It was the first time my pet had a consultation with Dr. Leonardo and we loved it! The doctor was very attentive, objective, and clear in his explanations, and he made us feel very safe. Furthermore, the home visit was great for Porthos, as he was in pain and we avoided having to travel with him. He is definitely Porthos's new veterinarian, I highly recommend him.

An excellent professional, very attentive and helpful.
It's clear that Dr. Leonardo does what he loves :)

Dr. Leonardo came to visit my dog ​​who was having a very bad back problem, and he gave me excellent initial care to help me with her. He follows up whenever I need help and to answer questions. I highly recommend him!

Dr. Leonardo cared for our Nina for 17 years. A little dog who, since she was a puppy, had a problem with bladder stones. The doctor was essential for her to live well and with a good quality of life, and we owe those 17 years to him. Always assertive, attentive, and extremely competent. Now a new member is arriving, and of course, there can't be a better professional to accompany her!

Natalia, thank you so much for your 5-star review and for your trust in my work.

I'm happy to hear you're satisfied.

I'm available to care for the health and well-being of pets with attention and responsibility here in São Paulo.

Call me whenever you need!
A simple, humanized service full of knowledge. I felt very safe with Leo's service. Yoshi and I recommend him.

Excellent professional! I was very grateful for the in-home service. My cat is sensitive and gets stressed outside her environment, so the home visit made all the difference. Dr. Leonardo was extremely careful, patient, and demonstrated genuine love for animals.
He explained each procedure clearly and put me at ease during the consultation. I recommend him for his competence, dedication, humane and trustworthy service!
Excellent professional!! Thank you for taking such good care of my four-legged girls 🥰 …
